_note: Inputs to the dispatch advice (src/shared/decide.ts) and the priority band (src/shared/priority.ts). EVERY number here is our own starting value, not a sourced figure; the app labels them as assumptions. They come from the Round 2 prototype, where they were marked 'placeholder'. To replace one, add the source in its 'note' and bump 'version'. Sources checked on 2026-11-25 without a usable figure: Azadpur APMC daily prices (no November 2026 Delicious quote found), National Horticulture Board apple notes and Indian shelf-life studies (storage conditions differ from a loaded truck).
